gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-ogham: Snowburst One cuts its letters like a stencil sheet, with wide bridges between them and lowercase that stands remarkably tall. Noto Sans Ogham, clean and contemporary, gives that stencil shout somewhere to rest.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-runic: Expressive and bold, Snowburst One looks like a stencil sheet with tall lowercase, while Noto Sans Runic brings a big x-height. Its curves stay modern and unfussy, so paragraphs read smoothly.
gen-gf-snowburst-one-gf-noto-sans-tagban: Stencil cuts and tall lowercase: Snowburst One looks like a sheet punched out with wide bridges between letters. Noto Sans Tagbanwa keeps things modern and open, giving the stencil room.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-fresca: Tektur draws pipe-cleaner strokes with generous openings on every curve. Fresca, the sans-serif text face, keeps counters connected to outside space, with short ascenders over big bowls and no calligraphic thinning.
